title: IA-MNS Implementation Plan
html:
Project human actions · Project derivation · Validation · Documentation index

Purpose and baseline

This is IA-MNS's living execution plan and the current plan for this repository. It tracks product and repository work; the README, current policies, and accepted ADRs govern implementation.

IA-MNS was initialized on 2026-10-01 from Orion commit 53bcc705a9f68f01aa1bbea3a0f4df4a009577ea of https://github.com/GabriellMDias/Orion. The project manifest records that immutable initialization commit and the Orion baseline currently integrated. The repository starts with the foundation's architecture, policies, ADRs, tooling, validation gate, CI, generated references, and Living Documentation Portal, and with no product modules. Results recorded for the Orion repository are not results for this repository until they pass in this checkout and in this repository's CI.

Maintaining this plan

Every contributor or coding agent performing implementation work must maintain this plan and the project human actions within the user's authorized scope.

  1. Before implementation, inspect actual repository state, the relevant task, its prerequisites, governing policy, and linked human actions. Do not treat a planned capability or unchecked action as available.
  2. Mark a task in progress when work actually starts. Update statuses when evidence, scope, dependencies, or blockers change, and before each handoff or completion report.
  3. Allocate stable task IDs as PJ-NN; never reuse or renumber them. Add finer tasks when needed; do not hide unfinished subtasks inside a completed row.
  4. Record concise evidence in the task row: implementation paths, validation commands and results, review references, or a linked decision. Record evidence produced for this repository—local validation, this repository's CI runs, and this repository's external settings. Do not store secret values or sensitive output.
  5. A task becomes completed only when its deliverables and acceptance criteria are satisfied with evidence. A partial implementation or an unavailable required check is not completion.
  6. When human intervention is necessary, add or update a project human action, link it from the affected task, mark that task blocked, and tell the user what is needed. Continue independent authorized work where possible.
  7. A future prerequisite is pending, not automatically blocked.
  8. When scope or sequencing changes, use changed, explain why and what replaces the work, and link supporting decisions. Do not delete unresolved obligations to make the plan look complete.
  9. Update command availability, current documentation, generated artifacts, and the human actions in the same coherent change where applicable. Do not change ADR status merely to record implementation progress.
Status Meaning
pending Not started; includes conditional work whose trigger has not occurred.
in progress Work has started and is incomplete.
completed Applicable deliverables and acceptance criteria are satisfied with evidence.
blocked The identified work cannot proceed without a recorded dependency, decision, access, or correction.
changed Scope, applicability, or sequencing was explicitly revised; reason and replacement or disposition are recorded.

Constraints throughout implementation

  • Retain the accepted stack recorded in the technology map; incompatibilities require explicit resolution rather than silent substitution.
  • Add product capabilities as API modules and web modules composed in apps/api/src/modules.ts and apps/web/src/modules.tsx; Orion's reference implementation shows a complete example.
  • Deliver tests, security controls, telemetry, and documentation with the behavior they protect.
  • Keep generated artifacts reproducible and subordinate to canonical sources. Reviewed SQL migrations follow their separate release-history rules.
  • Require non-mutating pnpm validate for substantial changes, using the same capabilities locally and in CI.
  • Adopt newer Orion revisions only through the reviewed upgrade workflow.

Current work

Task Scope Status Evidence / dependency
PJ-01 Publish the default branch to this project's origin, then verify that pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and pnpm validate pass and that this repository's required CI gate runs and passes. completed Local frozen installation and full gate passed on 2026-10-01. PH-01 completed: origin/main matches the initialization commit, and push CI run 36878872646 passed Validate and Orion required gate on 2026-10-01. Required-gate evidence on a pull request continues under PJ-14 and PH-02.
PJ-02 Define the product scope, actors, first capabilities, data classification, and acceptance criteria; replace the README introduction. completed Owner request of 2026-10-01; sales scope and acceptance.
PJ-03 Implement the sales API/web module, read-only Oracle adapter, bounded AI interpretation, context, contracts, tests, generated artifacts, and documentation. No application table or ERP migration is needed. completed API module, sales result renderer, decision, generated API/SDK/portal. Local pnpm validate passed on 2026-10-01, including 18 browser journeys. Provider boundary tests use synthetic data; live acceptance remains PJ-06.
PJ-06 Configure dedicated external providers and reconcile live Portuguese questions and Oracle 12.1 totals against the owner's reference. blocked On 2026-10-01, nine structured queries and the complete current-period reference projection matched real Oracle 12.1.0.2 data using isolated Client 19.32. Actual HTTP/Oracle comparison and empty-result checks passed with a controlled planner. Description matching, query budgets, comparison products, formatting, and malformed provider results were hardened. Live evidence and limits. The owner subsequently provisioned a key manually and authorized reuse; PH-07 is complete. Ten actual language requests, eight direct original-SQL reconciliations, and real-browser acceptance passed; live verification. PH-08 still blocks the dedicated SELECT-only account and weight/currency confirmation.
PJ-07 Audit the complete sales MVP for internal-pilot readiness, correct relevant defects, review desktop/mobile presentation, and rerun Orion's full gate without adding domains. completed Readiness audit, 2026-10-01: model clarification text removed; socket budgets, comparison boundaries, bounded monthly filling, Oracle response scope, and previous-only/negative result presentation corrected. Actual HTTP with real Oracle passed comparison, no-result, and 311-row product detail using a controlled planner. Desktop/mobile synthetic journeys and accessibility passed. Frozen installation and full pnpm validate passed: 82 API tests, 63 web unit tests, 5 browser tests, 19 end-to-end journeys. Subsequent PJ-08 verified live interpretation and browser behavior with the owner-authorized key; shared rollout remains dependent on PH-08 and PJ-05.
PJ-08 Diagnose the reported live sales runtime failure, validate existing OpenAI credentials and Oracle separately, then reconcile live natural-language sales queries. completed Live verification, 2026-10-01: supplied runtime event confirmed DPI-1047 during native client loading; fresh Thin reproduced NJS-116. Compatible Client 19.32 and a complete watcher restart restored the runtime. Existing key/model and Oracle were separately validated. Ten real HTTP scenarios passed; eight numerical answers matched the original SQL, and the real browser question/reconciliation/context deletion passed. Internal diagnostics now identify provider/stage, with redaction regressions. Frozen installation and full pnpm validate passed: 86 API tests, 63 web unit tests, 5 browser tests, 19 end-to-end journeys. PH-07 is complete; PH-08 still requires a dedicated SELECT-only account and unit confirmations.
PJ-09 Evolve IA-MNS into the corporate agent: implemented-capability catalog, grounded conversation, actual execution progress, light/dark themes, local Docker PostgreSQL and durable actor-owned conversation/context. Preserve the sales capability and run Orion gates. completed Architecture, ADR-0019, verification, 2026-10-01: implemented and locally provisioned. Fourteen real HTTP scenarios and eight original-SQL reconciliations passed; actual PostgreSQL/API restart recovery and real-browser context continuation passed. Frozen installation and complete local pnpm validate passed: 92 API, 63 web unit, five browser component tests and 20 end-to-end journeys. Shared lifecycle/release controls remain conditional PH-09/PH-10; PH-08 remains unchanged.
PJ-10 Enable temporary owner-controlled phone testing on a selected LAN interface without exposing credential-free developer access, databases or production authentication. completed ADR-0020, procedure, 2026-10-01: separate private-interface web/loopback API, expiring bearer and HTTP Web Crypto UUID fallback implemented. Actual LAN-origin mobile-viewport browser passed social chat, real OpenAI/Oracle monthly apple sales and persisted history recovery; missing/incorrect bearer and foreign origin rejected. Duplicate launch preserves the active credential; credential files and logs remain protected. Existing Node firewall rules needed no change. Complete local pnpm validate passed: 94 API, 63 web unit, five browser component tests and 20 end-to-end journeys. Physical phone reachability still needs the owner's device test; router/client isolation was not verified from that device.
PJ-11 Give the corporate agent a full-window conversation layout with a collapsible desktop sidebar, modal mobile history, and compact light/dark presentation. completed Presentation, 2026-10-01: removed outer card/margins and duplicate product header; neutral light/dark workspace, 260-pixel collapsible desktop history, native mobile modal and bottom composer implemented. Synthetic browser checks and visual review covered 1366×768/1024×600 notebooks and 390×844/320×568 mobile viewports, accessible themes/modal keyboard recovery, full available width and retained conversation state. Actual local runtime reopened/reloaded an existing monthly result and exercised sidebar/mobile controls without new provider requests. Complete local pnpm validate passed: 94 API, 63 web unit, five browser component tests and 21 end-to-end journeys.
PJ-04 Replace the neutral placeholder brand mark and touch icon with the product's visual identity. completed IA-MNS monogram in canonical SVG; touch icon regenerated with pnpm -C apps/web identity:write. Desktop/mobile chat preview reviewed on 2026-10-01.
PJ-12 Restore the original shared product/documentation colors while preserving PJ-11's full-window layout and collapsible history. completed Owner clarification of 2026-10-02: removed only the workspace's neutral palette overrides, reusing the existing light/dark tokens in styles.css. Existing theme/persistence/accessibility browser journey passed across desktop/mobile and documentation; restored colors were visually reviewed and stylesheet formatting passed. PJ-11's layout and behavior remain unchanged.
PJ-13 Animate and resize the sidebar, retain a collapsed icon rail, and persist per-conversation organization/search while preserving palettes and sales behavior. completed Verification, 2026-10-02: owner-scoped rename/pin/archive/restore/search, additive local migration, native menus/modals, pointer/keyboard resize and reduced-motion transitions implemented. Actual local HTTP/PostgreSQL reconnect verified metadata, search, restore/delete and preserved existing history count without provider calls. Complete local pnpm validate passed: 95 API tests, 63 web unit tests, five browser component tests and 23 end-to-end journeys. Generated API/SDK/schema/portal and lifecycle documentation updated. No new human blocker.
PJ-14 Reconcile the plan, human actions, and documentation with the verified repository settings, apply the owner's Apache-2.0 license decision, and open the first pull request with all work developed so far. in progress 2026-10-03: verified publication, the main ruleset, Renovate, and GitHub security settings through the GitHub API; PH-01, PH-03, and PH-06 are complete. ADR-0021 records the license. PH-02 and PH-04 still need evidence from the first pull request run: the required gate and dependency review. Merging stays with the owner.
PJ-05 Select an identity provider when the product needs one, and establish deployment-specific operation (hosting, secrets, database, telemetry, backups, alerts, runbooks) when real environment requirements exist. pending Conditional; add project human actions when triggered. As of 2026-10-03, employee identity, authentication, and authorization are still under discussion; no provider has been selected and shared deployment has not been triggered (PH-09). Governing policies: production access, secrets, retention, alerting, incident response, runbook authoring.

Progress and plan changes

PJ-13 completed on 2026-10-02 with the owner-requested sidebar interaction and durable conversation organization. Existing shared palettes and sales semantics were preserved; no additional business capability was introduced.

On 2026-10-03, PJ-14 began. It reconciles the plan with the owner's repository setup (publication, protection, Renovate, security controls) and the Apache-2.0 license decision, and opens the first pull request that brings the corporate agent and its sales capability into the published history. The product direction is the extensible corporate agent; sales remains its only implemented business capability.

Current task statuses own progress. Git preserves detailed editing history. Do not remove unresolved tasks or activation conditions when consolidating completed work.
